title: Derived evaluation at a weakly etale object and canonical restriction
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring. For b:T -> X weakly etale, t:Z -> T, a:Z -> X with t;b=a, and any unbounded derived Lambda_X-module K, the canonical derived evaluation restriction E_(X,b)(K) -> RGamma(Z,a-star K) [def-sfb-closed-fibre-module-evaluation] is invertible if and only if the canonical terminal section restriction RGamma(T,b-star K) -> RGamma(Z,t-star b-star K) [lem-sfb-closed-torsion-rigidity-serre-transfer] is invertible. No properness, closedness or coefficient finiteness is assumed.

proof.text: Use the adopted source-library weaklyEtaleLowerShriekAdjunction on abelian sheaves. Its left adjoint is exact. The existing isomorphism of internal-Hom comparisons for weakly etale inverse image implies its projection formula, by Functor.Monoidal.isIso_projectionMap_of_isIso_ihomComparison. Lift the adjunction to internal modules with Adjunction.mapModLeftAdjunction, and compose with restriction/coextension of scalars along the coefficient isomorphism. Extension and coextension along that isomorphism agree. The resulting exact left adjoint to upperStar on internal modules proves preservation of K-injective complexes.

proof.text: Identify the underlying sheaf of the module inverse image using extendScalarsIsoComapInv. The formula upperStarLowerStarAdjunction_homEquiv_hom and extendUnitHom_extendScalarsIsoComapInv_hom_app show that the specified module section restriction becomes the specified sheaf unit followed by restriction along the diagonal. The adopted germ_comp_upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction identifies this with restriction along an isomorphism of site objects. Thus localization sections at b are naturally isomorphic to terminal sections after b-star. On a K-injective representative, rightDerivedFunctorUnitQ_rightDerivedPullback_app' identifies the derived localization map as a composite of isomorphisms; transport along the representative isomorphism gives invertibility on every unbounded derived object.

proof.text: Use conjugateIsoEquiv_upperStarComp and unit_conjugateEquiv to obtain the module adjunction unit composition identity. Evaluate on b, use naturality twice, and verify the equality of the two site pullback lifts by pullback.hom_ext. This identifies the actual underived restriction for t;b with localization followed by the actual terminal restriction for t, up to upperStarComp. Apply rightDerivedPullback_comp and cancel both the invertible derived compositor and the derived localization map. Substitution along ha gives the statement unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem weaklyEtale_derived_evaluation_restriction_iff
    {X T Z : Scheme.{u}} (b : T ⟶ X) [WeaklyEtale b] (t : Z ⟶ T)
    (a : Z ⟶ X) (ha : t ≫ b = a)
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))) :
    IsIso ((closedFibreModuleDerivedRestriction Λ a (Scheme.ProEt.mk b) t ha).app K) ↔
      IsIso ((torsionRigidityDerivedRestriction Λ t).app
        ((upperStar Λ b).mapDerivedCategory.obj K))
